scope_note: Names and definitions identify the programme and development scope. They do not establish a completed game, validated model, biological or clinical capability.
release_policy: Current experimental previews are published with their actual edition and known limitations. Current selected files replace superseded live copies; Git history and original local evidence remain. Preview publication does not establish finished-product acceptance.
license_note: Project-owned contributions CC0-1.0; third-party materials retain their own rights and notices.
development_status: Model work active; presentation and matched-script work paused.
programme_focus: All three projects are active, with priority NeuroTranslation, NeuroSurge, then Interoceptomics.

experimental_model_preview.change: The viewer adds a left red nucleus surface from the same atlas. Explicit isolation reveals it; Restore context brings back the full scene.

experimental_model_preview.limitations: 121 of 141 occupied atlas labels, 41 meshes, 31 individually isolatable labels, 83 labels with combined surface samples, seven with atlas entries only and 20 without included surfaces. Original source-left only. Quantitative anatomy, functional claims, native visuals and full export acceptance remain open.

software_checks.kind: Constructed exact-handler two-vertex CPU colour-input fixture; renderer, scene, DOM and camera substituted.
software_checks.historical_scope: Earlier R6 constructed control-fixture evidence. R9 and R10 Chromium observations are separate.

verification_limits.C01: The original AMD/RADV isolate/lateral/deep visual check remains open. R10 used software rendering.
verification_limits.renderer: ANGLE (AMD, Vulkan 1.4.354 (AMD Radeon 8060S Graphics (RADV STRIX_HALO) (0x00001586)), radv)
verification_limits.pending: Full browser controls, GPU/colour appearance, performance, real-reference SERIES, anatomy, donor/scale/function, rights/privacy, held-out, native visual/export, OS and actual documentation layout/font fallback.
verification_limits.earlier_images_and_pixel_results: Earlier images and pixel results describe their original builds and test conditions.
verification_limits.retained_C01_stop: SwiftShader/wrong-window readiness STOP before control actions; original AMD/RADV target and thresholds retained.
verification_limits.startup: R9 retained four HTTP 404 tests. R10 checked normal startup and a blocked optional red nucleus asset. Other faults and rendering-context loss remain open.

experimental_model_preview.launchers: Windows, macOS and Linux launchers require Python 3.10+ and a WebGL browser. The R10 Linux launcher opened the tested model through its loopback address. Default-browser opening and native Windows/macOS execution remain unverified.

startup_error_source_checks.limits: Module import/parse errors, pre-try constants and later asynchronous interaction failures remain outside the repair; exotic thrown-value coercions remain unqualified.

historical_package_R8_viewer_check.scope: Headless Linux Chromium 155, ANGLE SwiftShader. Initial view matched R7 byte for byte at 900 × 517. Lateral, insula group and isolation state matched. A missing geometry file returned HTTP 404, displayed recovery guidance and left viewer readiness unset. A manual reload after restoring the file opened all 40 meshes.

viewer_runtime_check.scope: Linux Chromium/SwiftShader on the packaged Linux launcher. Exact R9 default and restored canvas, keyboard-selected left atlas isolation, focus, rotation, ordinary Insula and missing optional GLB readback.

red_nucleus.evidence: Exact atlas-derived geometry independently checked. Comparison to separate MRI and histology remains qualitative.

historical_package_R9_viewer_check.scope: Headless Linux Chromium 155 with ANGLE SwiftShader. Exact R8 initial 555 × 517 3D canvas match. Keyboard evidence covers source-only, shared samples and separate mesh choices, focus, isolation, reset and filtering. Four HTTP 404 cases kept controls locked.
